```lean
theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} {a b : R} [CommRing R] {r : R} : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R := by
  split
  · intro hnz
    intros w hzw
    rw [nonZeroDivisors_def] at hzw
    rcases hzw with ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff_dvd] at hz1 hz2
    exact hnz hz1 hz2
  · intro hnz
    intros w hzw
    rw [nonZeroDivisors_def] at hzw
    rcases hzw with ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff] at hz1 hz2
    exact hnz hz1 hz2
```
